505:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
506:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)

508:               continue;
509:             }

515:             }
516:         }

518:         {
519:           active = &g_active;
520:           if (active->quarantine)
521:             {
522:               return -ENOLINK;
523:             }
524:         }
525:       else
526:         {
527:           return OK;
528:         }
529: 
530:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)

532:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
533:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
534:                  sizeof(active->message));
535:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
536:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
537:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
538:             g_channel_ids[i]);
539:         }
540: 
541:       active->callback = channel->callback;
542:       active->arg = channel->arg;
543:       active->channel_index = i;
544:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
545:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
546:       if (ret < 0)

549:         }

551:       active->busy = true;
552:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
553:         {
554:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)

557:             }

569: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
570:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
571:   const struct active_transaction *active)
572: {
573:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
574:   uint32_t reason = 0;
575: 
576:   if (!active->busy)
577:     {
578:       return 1u;
579:     }
580: 
581:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
582:     {
583:       reason |= 2u;
584:     }
585:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
586:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
587:     {
588:       reason |= 4u;
589:     }
590:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
591:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
592:     {

177:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN1);

197:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();

200:           if (bk7258_smp_boot_ping(1) < 0)

203:             }

369: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
370: {
371:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
372:   struct pwc_message message;
373:   unsigned int next;
374: 
375:   if (bytes == NULL)
376:     {
377:       return;
378:     }
379: 
380:   /* The logical mailbox invokes PWC callbacks while holding the driver lock.
381:    * Keep the queue update in that critical section instead of recursively
382:    * acquiring the non-recursive SMP spinlock here. */
383: 
384:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
385:   if (next == g_tail)
386:     {
387:       return;
388:     }
389: 
390:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
391:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
392:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
393:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
394:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
395:   g_head = next;
396:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
397: }

225: static bool mb_chnl_rx_ready(void)
226: {
227: 	/* Keep one ACK slot available for the command currently being handled.
228: 	 * A command must not be consumed and its business callback run if its
229: 	 * transport ACK cannot be queued. */
230: 	return ack_count < MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN - 1;
231: }
232: 
233: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
234: {
235: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
236: 
237: 	while (1)
238: 	{
239: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
240: 		bk_err_t ret;
241: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
242: 
243: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
244: 		{
245: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
246: 			return;
247: 		}
248: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
249: 		ack_sending = 1;
250: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
251: 
252: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
253: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
254: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
255: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
256: 		{
257: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
258: 			ack_sending = 0;
259: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
260: 			return;
261: 		}
262: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
263: 		ack_count--;
264: 		ack_sending = 0;
265: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
266: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
267: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
268: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
269: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
270: 	}
271: }

273: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)
274: {
275: 	u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
276: 	mb_ack_entry_t *entry;
277: 
278: 	if (ack_count >= MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN - 1)
279: 	{
280: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
281: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
282: 		return false;
283: 	}
284: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
285: 	entry->data = *data;
286: 	entry->destination = destination;
287: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
288: 	ack_count++;
289: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
290: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
291: 	return true;
292: }

359: 
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
361: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
362: 
363: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
364: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
365: 
366: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
367: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
368: 
369: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
370: 
371: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
372: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
373: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
374: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
375: 
376: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
377: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_cmd_header = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
378: 
379: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
380: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
381: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
382: 
383: 	__DMB();
384: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
385: 
386: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
387: 
388: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
389: 
390: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
391: 	{
392: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
393: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
394: 
395: 		return ret_code;
396: 	}
397: 
398: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
399: 
400: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
401: 
402: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
403: 	{
404: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
405: 	}
406: 
407: 	return BK_OK;
408: }

410: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
411: {
412: 	u8		log_chnl;
413: 	u8		ret_code;
414: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
415: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
416: 
417: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
418: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
419: 
420: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
421: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
422: 	{
423: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
424: 
425: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
426: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
427: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
428: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
429: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
430: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
431: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
432: 		{
433: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
434: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
435: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
436: 			return;
437: 		}
438: 
439: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
440: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
441: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
442: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
443: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
444: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
445: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
446: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
447: 		{
448: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
449: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
450: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
451: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
452: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
453: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
454: 			{
455: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
456: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
457: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
458: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
459: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
460: 			}
461: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
462: 		}
463: 		else
464: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
465: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
466: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
467: 		return;
468: 	}
469: 
470: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
471: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
472: 
473: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
474: 
475: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
476: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
477: 		return;
478: 	}
479: 
480: 
481: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
482: 	{
483: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
484: 		return;
485: 	}
486: 
487: 
488: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
489: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
490: 		return;
491: 	}
492: 
493: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
494: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_header = ack_ptr->hdr.data;
495: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_data1 = ack_ptr->data1;
496: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
497: 
498: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
499: 	{
500: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
501: 		return;
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
505: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
506: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
507: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
508: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
509: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
510: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
511: 	{
512: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
513: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
514: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
515: 		return;
516: 	}
517: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
518: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
519: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
520: 
521: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
522: 
523: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
524: 	{
525: 		/* clear following header members. */
526: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
527: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
528: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
529: 
530: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
531: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
532: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
533: 	} else {
534: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
535: 	}
536: 
537: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
538: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
539: 	{
540: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
541: 		return;
542: 	}
543: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
544: 	{
545: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
546: 			break;
547: 	}
548: 
549: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
550: 	{
551: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
552: 		return;
553: 	}
554: 
555: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
556: 
557: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
558: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
559: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
560: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
561: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
562: 
563: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
564: 
565: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
566: 	{
567: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
568: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
569: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
570: 	}
571: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
572: 
573: 	return;
574: 
575: }

577: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
578: {
579: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
580: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
581: 
582: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
583: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
584: 
585: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
586: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
587: 
588: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
589: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
590: 
591: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
592: 
593: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
594: 		return;
595: 
596: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
597: 		return;
598: 
599: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
600: 		return;
601: 
602: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
603: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
604: 
605: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
606: 
607: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
608: 	{
609: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
610: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
611: 
612: 		return;
613: 	}
614: 
615: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr != NULL)
616: 	{
617: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
618: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
619: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
620: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
621: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
622: 
623: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
624: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
625: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
626: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
627: 	}
628: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
629: 	{
630: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
631: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
632: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
633: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
634: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
635: 
636: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
637: 
638: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
639: 	}
640: 	else
641: 	{
642: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
643: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
644: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
645: 	}
646: 
647: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
648: 	{
649: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
650: 		return;
651: 	}
652: 
653: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
654: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
655: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
656: 
657: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
658: 	{
659: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
660: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
661: 		return;
662: 	}
663: 	return;
664: }

666: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
667: {
668: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
669: 
670: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
671: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
672: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
673: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
674: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
675: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
676: 
677: 	/*
678: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
679: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
680: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
681: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
682: 	 */
683: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
684: 	{
685: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
686: 	}
687: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
688: 	{
689: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
690: 	}
691: }

693: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
694: {
695: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
696: 
697: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
698: 
699: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
700: 
701: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
702: 
703: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
704: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
705: 
706: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
707: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
708: 
709: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
710: 
711: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
712: 	{
713: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
714: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
715: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
716: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
717: 
718: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
719: 
720: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
721: 		{
722: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
723: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
724: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
725: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
726: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
727: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
728: 
729: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
730: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
731: 			}
732: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
733: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
734: 			return ret_code;
735: 		}
736: 	}
737: 
738: 	return BK_OK;
739: }

741: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
742: 
743: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
744: {
745: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
746: 	u16 			chnl_type;
747: 
748: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
749: 
750: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
751: 
752: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
753: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
754: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
755: #endif
756: 
757: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
758: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
759: 
760: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
761: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
762: 
763: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
764: 
765: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
766: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
767: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
768: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
769: 
770: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
771: 
772: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
773: 
774: 	/*
775: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
776: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
777: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
778: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
779: 	 */
780: 	while(1)
781: 	{
782: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
783: 
784: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
785: 		{
786: 			break;
787: 		}
788: 	}
789: 
790: 	return ret_code;
791: }

794: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
795: /*
796:   * init logical chnanel module.
797:   * return:
798:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
799:   *     failed  : fail code.
800:   *
801:   */
802: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
803: {
804: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
805: 	int				i, j;
806: 
807: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
808: 
809: 	/*
810: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
811: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
812: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
813: 	 * can race here:
814: 	 *
815: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
816: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
817: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
818: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
819: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
820: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
821: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
822: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
823: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
824: 	 *
825: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
826: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
827: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
828: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
829: 	 */
830: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
831: 	{
832: 		return BK_OK;
833: 	}
834: 
835: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
836: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
837: 	{
838: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
839: 		return BK_OK;

125: static void ipc_cmd_rx_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
126: {
127: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
128: 	mb_chnl_ack_t * ack_buf = (mb_chnl_ack_t *)cmd_buf;
129: 	ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
130: 
131: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
132: 
133: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_FLAG)  /* ipc rsp from other CPU. */
134: 	{
135: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
136: 		{
137: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
138: 		}
139: 
140: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd != (cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_MASK))
141: 		{
142: 			/* un-matched rpc response. */
143: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
144: 		}
145: 
146: 		/* communication ok, function is completed. */
147: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
148: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
149: 
150: 		BK_LOGD(MOD_TAG, "IPC_RSP_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
151: 
152: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
153: 		{
154: 			/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
155: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
156: 			chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
157: 		}
158: 		else
159: 		{
160: 			/* returns ACK_STATE_COMPLETE,
161: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
162: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
163: 			{
164: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
165: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
166: 				#endif
167: 				__DMB();
168: 
169: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
170: 
171: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
172: 			}
173: 			else
174: 			{
175: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
176: 			}
177: 		}
178: 
179: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
180: 
181: 		ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
182: 
183: 		/* it is a rsp command, nothing need to be returned. */
184: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = NULL;
185: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
186: 
187: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
188: 
189: 		goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
190: 	}
191: 	else
192: 	{
193: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
194: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 1;
195: 
196: 		BK_LOGV(MOD_TAG, "IPC_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
197: 
198: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->cmd_buf))
199: 		{
200: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
201: 		}
202: 		else
203: 		{
204: 			/* may return ACK_STATE_COMPLETE,
205: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
206: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
207: 			{
208: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
209: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
210: 				#endif
211: 				__DMB();
212: 
213: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->cmd_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 
215: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
216: 			}
217: 			else
218: 			{
219: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = 0;
220: 			}
221: 
222: 			result = chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler(chnl_cb, ack_buf);
223: 		}
224: 
225: 		if(result != ACK_STATE_PENDING)
226: 			chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 0;
227: 	}
228: 
229: ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit:
230: 
231: 	/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle complete.
232: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
233: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
234: 	 */
235: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;
236: 
237: 	return;
238: 
239: }

241: static void ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
242: {
243: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.cmd == chnl_cb->tx_cmd)
244: 	{
245: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* RSP_CMD rx_isr may arrive before this tx_cmpl_isr. */
246: 			return;
247: 
248: 		/* IPC cmd tx complete. */
249: 
250: 		if( (ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
251: 			|| (ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_FAIL) )
252: 		{
253: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
254: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;
255: 
256: 			/* communication failed or function failed. */
257: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
258: 		}
259: 		else if(ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_COMPLETE)
260: 		{
261: 			/* communication ok, function is completed. */
262: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
263: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
264: 
265: 			ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
266: 
267: 			/* chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
268: 
269: 			if(ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
270: 			{
271: 				/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
272: 				chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
273: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
274: 			}
275: 			else
276: 			{
277: 				if((ipc_rsp->rsp_buff != NULL) && (ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > 0))
278: 				{
279: 					#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
280: 					flush_dcache(ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
281: 					#endif
282: 					__DMB();
283: 
284: 					memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
285: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len;
286: 				}
287: 				else
288: 				{
289: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
290: 				}
291: 			}
292: 
293: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
294: 		}
295: 		else
296: 		{
297: 			/* communication ok, function is pending. */
298: 		}
299: 
300: 		return;
301: 	}
302: 
303: 	/*
304: 	 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
305: 	 */
306: 	BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault in %s,cmd:%d\r\n", __func__, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
307: 
308: 	return;
309: 
310: }

312: static bk_err_t ipc_chnl_init(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id, ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t rx_handler)

326: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )

334: 		return ret_code;

339: 	{
340: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);

342: 		return ret_code;

346: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)

364: static bk_err_t ipc_send_cmd(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 cmd, u8 *cmd_buf, u16 cmd_len, u8 * rsp_buf, u16 rsp_buf_len)
365: {
366: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
367: 	ipc_cmd_t	ipc_cmd;
368: 
369: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited){
370: 		ipc_init();
371: 	}
372: 
373: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
374: 		return BK_FAIL;
375: 
376: 	rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
377: 
378: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = cmd;
379: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
380: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 1;
381: 
382: 	void * dst_buf = (void *)chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff;
383: 
384: 	do
385: 	{
386: 		if(cmd_len > IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
387: 		{
388: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
389: 			break;
390: 		}
391: 
392: 		if(cmd_buf == NULL)
393: 			cmd_len = 0;
394: 
395: 		if(cmd_len > 0)
396: 			memcpy(dst_buf, cmd_buf, cmd_len);
397: 
398: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.data = 0;	/* clear hdr. */
399: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = cmd;
400: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_buff      = dst_buf;
401: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cmd_len;
402: 
403: 		ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&ipc_cmd);
404: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
405: 		{
406: 			break;
407: 		}
408: 
409: 		ret_val = rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, IPC_RSP_TIMEOUT);  /* isr_callback will set this semaphore. */
410: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
411: 		{
412: 			break;
413: 		}
414: 
415: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;  /* must have been set to 0 by callback. */
416: 
417: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed)
418: 		{
419: 			ret_val = BK_FAIL;
420: 			break;
421: 		}
422: 
423: 		if((rsp_buf == NULL) || (rsp_buf_len == 0))
424: 		{
425: 			ret_val = BK_OK;
426: 			break;
427: 		}
428: 
429: 		if(rsp_buf_len < chnl_cb->rsp_len)
430: 		{
431: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
432: 			break;
433: 		}
434: 
435: 		if(chnl_cb->rsp_len > 0)
436: 			memcpy(rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_len);
437: 
438: 		ret_val = BK_OK;
439: 
440: 	}while(0);
441: 
442: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
443: 
444: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
445: 
446: 	return ret_val;
447: 
448: }

515: static u32 ipc_cmd_handler(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)
516: {
517: 	/* must NOT change ack_buf->hdr. */
518: 
519: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
520: 	ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
521: 
522: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
523: 
524: 	ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff;
525: 
526: 	switch(chnl_cb->rx_cmd)
527: 	{
528: 		case IPC_RES_AVAILABLE_INDICATION:
529: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u16))
530: 			{
531: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
532: 
533: 				u16  res_id = *((u16 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf);
534: 
535: 				if(amp_res_available(res_id) == BK_OK)
536: 				{
537: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
538: 				}
539: 				else
540: 				{
541: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
542: 				}
543: 			}
544: 			else
545: 			{
546: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
547: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
548: 			}
549: 			break;
550: 
551: 		case IPC_TEST_CMD:
552: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
553: 			{
554: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
555: 
556: 				u32 * p_src = (u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
557: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
558: 
559: 				*p_dst = (*p_src) + 1;
560: 
561: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
562: 			}
563: 			else
564: 			{
565: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
566: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
567: 			}
568: 			break;
569: 
570: 		case IPC_GET_POWER_SAVE_FLAG:
571: 			{
572: 				// return PS flag to caller.
573: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
574: 
575: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
576: 
577: 				mb_ipc_get_power_save_state(p_dst);
578: 
579: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
580: 			}
581: 			break;
582: 
583: #if (USB_CDC_CP1_IPC)
584: 		case IPC_CPU0_START_USB_CDC:
585: 			{
586: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
587: 				bk_usb_cdc_start();
588: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
589: 			}
590: 			break;
591: 
592: 		case IPC_CPU0_CLOSE_USB_CDC:
593: 			{
594: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
595: 				bk_usb_cdc_close();
596: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
597: 			}
598: 			break;
599: 		case IPC_CPU0_STOP_USB_CDC:
600: 			{
601: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
602: 				bk_usb_cdc_stop();
603: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
604: 			}
605: 			break;
606: 
607: 		case IPC_CPU0_INIT_USB_CDC_PARAM:
608: 			{
609: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
610: 				IPC_CDC_DATA_t *p_cdc_data = (IPC_CDC_DATA_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
611: 				bk_usb_cdc_init(p_cdc_data);
612: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
613: 			}
614: 			break;
615: 
616: 		case IPC_CPU0_SET_USB_CDC_CMD:
617: 			{
618: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
619: 				IPC_CDC_DATA_t *p_cdc_data = (IPC_CDC_DATA_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
620: 				bk_cdc_acm_bulkout(p_cdc_data);
621: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
622: 			}
623: 			break;
624: #endif
625: 
626: #if (USB_CDC_CP0_IPC)
627: 		case IPC_CPU1_UPLOAD_USB_CDC_DATA:
628: 			{
629: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
630: 				IPC_CDC_DATA_t *p_cdc_data = (IPC_CDC_DATA_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
631: 				if (p_cdc_data->bk_cdc_acm_bulkin_cb) {
632: 					p_cdc_data->bk_cdc_acm_bulkin_cb();
633: 				}
634: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
635: 			}
636: 			break;
637: 		case IPC_CPU1_UPDATE_USB_CDC_STATE:
638: 			{
639: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
640: 				extern void (*usb_cdc_state_cb)(bk_cdc_hub_status * cdc_status);
641: 				bk_cdc_hub_status * cdc_status = (bk_cdc_hub_status *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
642: 				if (usb_cdc_state_cb) {
643: 					usb_cdc_state_cb(cdc_status);
644: 				}
645: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
646: 			}
647: 			break;
648: #endif
649: 
650: 
651: 		case IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION:		// cpu1 indication, power up successfully.
652: 			{
653: 				/* no params. */
654: 				/* inform modules who care CPU1 state. */
655: 				u8   on_cpu_id = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
656: 				mb_ipc_power_on_notify(on_cpu_id);
657: 				if (on_cpu_id == MAILBOX_CPU1)
658: 					ap_console_bridge_ready_update(AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC, true);
659: 
660: 				/* no returns. */
661: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
662: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
663: 			}
664: 			break;
665: 
666: 		case IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION:	// cpu1 indication, alive indication.
667: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
668: 			{
669: 				// contains any data?
670: 				// u32 * p_src = (u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
671: 
672: 				// save the param.
673: 
674: 				u8   hb_cpu_id = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
675: 				mb_ipc_heartbeat_notify(hb_cpu_id);
676: 
677: 			}
678: 
679: 			/* succeeded anyway but no returns. */
680: 			ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
681: 			result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
682: 			break;
683: 
684: 		case IPC_CPU1_TRAP_HANDLE_BEGIN:		// cpu1 indication, dump begin.
685: 			{
686: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
687: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
688: 
689:                 g_ap_dump_flag = 1;
690: 
691:                 /* if ap dump ,then cp shoule disable its most interruptions */
692:                 sys_drv_int_disable(0xFFFE7FE7);
693:                 sys_drv_int_group2_disable(0x7FFFFFFF);
694: 
695: 				u8   dump_cpu_id = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
696: 				mb_ipc_dump_notify(dump_cpu_id, 1);
697: 				/* no params, no returns. */
698: 				#if (CONFIG_SHELL_ASYNCLOG)
699: 				shell_set_log_cpu(dump_cpu_id);
700: 				#endif
701: 			}
702: 			break;
703: 
704: 		case IPC_CPU1_TRAP_HANDLE_END:		// cpu1 indication, dump end.
705: 			{
706: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
707: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
708: 
709:                 g_ap_dump_flag = 0;
710: 
711: 				u8   dump_cpu_id = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
712: 				mb_ipc_dump_notify(dump_cpu_id, 0);
713: 				/* no params, no returns. */
714: 				#if (CONFIG_SHELL_ASYNCLOG)
715: 				shell_set_log_cpu(SHELL_MAX_CPU_CNT);
716: 				shell_log_flush();
717: 				#endif
718: 				bk_wdt_force_reboot();
719: 			}
720: 			break;
721: 
722: 		case IPC_CPU1_NEED_REBOOT:
723: 			{
724: 			ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
725: 			result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
726: 			bk_wdt_force_reboot();
727: 			}
728: 			break;
729: 
730: 		#ifdef AMP_RES_SERVER
731: 		case IPC_RES_ACQUIRE_CNT:
732: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(ipc_res_req_t))
733: 			{
734: 				ipc_res_req_t * res_req = (ipc_res_req_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
735: 				amp_res_req_cnt_t * res_cnt_list = (amp_res_req_cnt_t *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
736: 
737: 				/* call amp_res_acquire_cnt in interrupt disabled state. */
738: 				u32  int_mask = ipc_enter_critical();
739: 				bk_err_t ret_code = amp_res_acquire_cnt(res_req->res_id, res_req->cpu_id, res_cnt_list);
740: 				ipc_exit_critical(int_mask);
741: 
742: 				if(ret_code == BK_OK)
743: 				{
744: 					ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(amp_res_req_cnt_t);
745: 
746: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
747: 				}
748: 				else
749: 				{
750: 					ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
751: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
752: 				}
753: 			}
754: 			else
755: 			{
756: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
757: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
758: 			}
759: 			break;
760: 
761: 		case IPC_RES_RELEASE_CNT:
762: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(ipc_res_req_t))
763: 			{
764: 				ipc_res_req_t * res_req = (ipc_res_req_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
765: 				amp_res_req_cnt_t * res_cnt_list = (amp_res_req_cnt_t *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
766: 
767: 				/* call amp_res_release_cnt in interrupt disabled state. */
768: 				u32  int_mask = ipc_enter_critical();
769: 				bk_err_t ret_code = amp_res_release_cnt(res_req->res_id, res_req->cpu_id, res_cnt_list);
770: 				ipc_exit_critical(int_mask);
771: 
772: 				if(ret_code == BK_OK)
773: 				{
774: 					ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(amp_res_req_cnt_t);
775: 
776: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
777: 				}
778: 				else
779: 				{
780: 					ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
781: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
782: 				}
783: 			}
784: 			else
785: 			{
786: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
787: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
788: 			}
789: 			break;
790: 
791: #if CONFIG_GENERAL_DMA
792: 		case IPC_ALLOC_DMA_CHNL:
793: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
794: 			{
795: 				u32  user_id = *((u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf);
796: 
797: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u8);
798: 
799: 				u8 * chnl_id = (u8 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
800: 
801: 				extern u8 dma_chnl_alloc(u32 user_id);
802: 
803: 				*chnl_id = dma_chnl_alloc(user_id);
804: 
805: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
806: 			}
807: 			else
808: 			{
809: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
810: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
811: 			}
812: 			break;
813: 
814: 		case IPC_FREE_DMA_CHNL:
815: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(ipc_dma_free_t))
816: 			{
817: 				ipc_dma_free_t * free_req = (ipc_dma_free_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
818: 
819: 				extern bk_err_t dma_chnl_free(u32 user_id, dma_id_t chnl_id);
820: 
821: 				bk_err_t ret_val = dma_chnl_free(free_req->user_id, (dma_id_t)free_req->chnl_id);
822: 
823: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
824: 
825: 				if(ret_val == BK_OK)
826: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
827: 				else
828: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
829: 			}
830: 			else
831: 			{
832: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
833: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
834: 			}
835: 			break;
836: 
837: 		case IPC_DMA_CHNL_USER:
838: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u8))
839: 			{
840: 				u8    chnl_id = *((u8 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf);
841: 
842: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
843: 
844: 				u32 * user_id = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
845: 
846: 				extern u32 dma_chnl_user(dma_id_t user_id);
847: 
848: 				*user_id = dma_chnl_user((dma_id_t)chnl_id);
849: 
850: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
851: 			}
852: 			else
853: 			{
854: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
855: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
856: 			}
857: 			break;
858: #endif
859: 
860: 		#endif
861: 
862: 		default:
863: 			{
864: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
865: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
866: 			}
867: 			break;
868: 	}
869: 
870: 	return result;
871: }

177: static bk_err_t pm_cp0_mailbox_send_data(uint32_t cmd, uint32_t param1,uint32_t param2,uint32_t param3)
178: {
179: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t mb_cmd = {0};
180: 	int ret              = 0;
181: 	uint8_t  retry_count = 0;
182: 	bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX,0,0);
183: 	mb_cmd.hdr.cmd = cmd;
184: 	mb_cmd.param1 = param1;
185: 	mb_cmd.param2 = param2;
186: 	mb_cmd.param3 = param3;
187: 	ret = mb_chnl_write(MB_CHNL_PWC, &mb_cmd);
188:     while(ret != BK_OK)
189: 	{
190: 	    retry_count++;
191: 		ret = mb_chnl_write(MB_CHNL_PWC, &mb_cmd);
192: 		rtos_delay_milliseconds(2);
193:         if(retry_count > 5)
194:         {
195:             LOGE("Mailbox send data fail[ret:%d]\r\n",ret);
196: 			bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX,1,0);
197:             return ret;
198:         }
199: 	}
200: 	bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX,1,0);
201: 	return BK_OK;
202: }

262: static void pm_cp0_mailbox_rx_isr(int *pm_mb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
263: {
264: 	bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
265: 
266: 	switch(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd) {
267: 		case PM_POWER_CTRL_CMD:
268: 			ret = pm_cp0_send_msg(LOW_PWR_CORE_POWER_CTRL, cmd_buf->param1,cmd_buf->param2,cmd_buf->param3);
269: 			break;
270: 		case PM_CLK_CTRL_CMD:
271: 			ret = pm_cp0_send_msg(LOW_PWR_CORE_CLK_CTRL, cmd_buf->param1,cmd_buf->param2,cmd_buf->param3);
272: 			break;
273: 		case PM_SLEEP_CTRL_CMD:
274: 			//bk_pm_cp0_response_cp1(PM_SLEEP_CTRL_CMD,BK_OK,0,0);//for more quick when enter lv
275: 			ret = pm_cp0_send_msg(LOW_PWR_CORE_SLEEP_CTRL, cmd_buf->param1,cmd_buf->param2,cmd_buf->param3);
276: 			break;
277: 		case PM_CPU_FREQ_CTRL_CMD:
278: 			ret = pm_cp0_send_msg(LOW_PWR_CORE_FREQ_CTRL, cmd_buf->param1,cmd_buf->param2,cmd_buf->param3);
279: 			break;
280: 		case PM_CTRL_EXTERNAL_LDO_CMD:
281: 			ret = pm_cp0_send_msg(LOW_PWR_CORE_EXTERNAL_LDO, cmd_buf->param1,cmd_buf->param2,cmd_buf->param3);
282: 			break;
283: 		case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
284: 			ret = pm_cp0_send_msg(LOW_PWR_CORE_PSRAM_POWER, cmd_buf->param1,cmd_buf->param2,cmd_buf->param3);
285: 			break;
286: 		case PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD:
287: 			if(cmd_buf->param1 == 0x1)
288: 			{
289: 				/* A local UART STATE ACK proves only CP->AP delivery.  Keep
290: 				 * ordinary CP transactions quarantined until AP confirms its

57: static void mbox0_reap_slots(u8 dst)
58: {
59: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
60: 	uint32_t fifo_count;
61: 	u32 reaped = 0;
62: 	u32 now;
63: 	u8 i;
64: 
65: 	if (mbox0_drv_get_send_count(dst, &fifo_count) != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
66: 		return;
67: 
68: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
69: 	if (fifo_count != 0)
70: 	{
71: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
72: 		return;
73: 	}
74: 
75: 	now = rtos_get_time();
76: 	if (!slots->fifo_empty_since_ms)
77: 	{
78: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = now ? now : 1;
79: 		return;
80: 	}
81: 	if ((u32)(now - slots->fifo_empty_since_ms) <
82: 		MBOX0_SLOT_QUARANTINE_MS)
83: 		return;
84: 
85: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
86: 	{
87: 		reaped += slots->cmd_used[i] != 0;
88: 		slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
89: 	}
90: 	/* The hardware FIFO contains pointers into these slots.  Once it has
91: 	 * remained empty for the quarantine interval, the peer has had ample time
92: 	 * to copy every published entry.  ACK-only AP traffic has no later command
93: 	 * fence, so retaining these slots indefinitely exhausts the pool during
94: 	 * RESET/STATE/PWC bring-up.
95: 	 */
96: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
97: 	{
98: 		reaped += slots->ack_used[i] != 0;
99: 		slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
100: 	}
101: 	reaped += slots->reset_used != 0;
102: 	reaped += slots->sync_used != 0;
103: 	slots->reset_used = 0;
104: 	slots->sync_used = 0;
105: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
106: 	slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
107: 	adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;
108: }

115: static mbox0_rx_desc_t *mbox0_oldest_desc(bool priority)
116: {
117: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *oldest = NULL;
118: 	u8 i;
119: 
120: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
121: 	{
122: 		u8 ctrl;
123: 
124: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
125: 			continue;
126: 		ctrl = (rx_desc[i].data.param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
127: 		if (((ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0) != priority)
128: 			continue;
129: 		if (!oldest || (int32_t)(rx_desc[i].order - oldest->order) < 0)
130: 			oldest = &rx_desc[i];
131: 	}

135: static mbox0_stable_slot_t *mbox0_alloc_slot(u8 dst, u8 ctrl,
136: 					     u8 *kind, u8 *index)
137: {
138: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
139: 	u8 i;
140: 
141: 	if (ctrl == (MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX | MBOX0_CTRL_RESET))
142: 	{
143: 		if (slots->reset_used)
144: 			return NULL;
145: 		slots->reset_used = 1;
146: 		slots->reset_order = ++slots->publish_order;
147: 		*kind = 2;
148: 		return &slots->reset;
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	if (ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
152: 	{
153: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
154: 		{
155: 			if (!slots->ack_used[i])
156: 			{
157: 				slots->ack_used[i] = 1;
158: 				slots->ack_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
159: 				*kind = 1;
160: 				*index = i;
161: 				return &slots->ack[i];
162: 			}
163: 		}
164: 		return NULL;
165: 	}
166: 
167: 	if (ctrl == MBOX0_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
168: 	{
169: 		if (slots->sync_used)
170: 			return NULL;
171: 		slots->sync_used = 1;
172: 		slots->sync_order = ++slots->publish_order;
173: 		*kind = 3;
174: 		return &slots->sync;
175: 	}
176: 
177: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
178: 	{
179: 		if (!slots->cmd_used[i])
180: 		{
181: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 1;
182: 			slots->cmd_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
183: 			slots->cmd_active = i + 1;
184: 			*kind = 0;
185: 			*index = i;
186: 			return &slots->cmd[i];
187: 		}
188: 	}
189: 
190: 	return NULL;
191: }

193: static void mbox0_release_slot(u8 dst, u8 kind, u8 index)

211: void bk_mailbox_poll(void)
212: {
213: 	u8 dst;
214: 
215: 	u32 flags = rtos_disable_int();
216: 	for (dst = 0; dst < MBOX_CHNL_NUM; dst++)
217: 	{
218: 		if (dst != MAILBOX_CPU0)
219: 			mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
220: 	}
221: 	mbox0_drv_poll();
222: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
223: 
224: 	while (1)
225: 	{
226: 		mbox0_rx_desc_t desc;
227: 		mbox0_rx_desc_t *selected;
228: 
229: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
230: 		if (!rx_count)
231: 		{
232: 			rtos_enable_int(flags);
233: 			break;
234: 		}
235: 		selected = mbox0_oldest_desc(true);
236: 		if (!selected)
237: 			selected = mbox0_oldest_desc(false);
238: 		if (!selected ||
239: 			(((selected->data.param0 >> 12) & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 &&
240: 			 upper_rx_ready && !upper_rx_ready()))
241: 		{
242: 			rtos_enable_int(flags);
243: 			break;
244: 		}
245: 		desc = *selected;
246: 		selected->used = 0;
247: 		rx_count--;
248: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
249: 		if (mailbox_callback[desc.source])
250: 			mailbox_callback[desc.source](&desc.data);
251: 
252: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
253: 		mbox0_drv_poll();
254: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
255: 	}
256: }

258: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
259: {
260: 	u32 address;
261: 	u32 source;
262: 	u32 reaped = 0;
263: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *desc;
264: 	u8 ctrl;
265: 	u8 i;
266: 
267: 	if (!msg)
268: 		return;
269: 
270: 	source = msg->src_cpu;
271: 	if (source != MAILBOX_CPU1)
272: 	{
273: 		adapter_diag.bad_sid++;
274: 		return;
275: 	}
276: 	if (msg->data[1] != sizeof(mailbox_data_t))
277: 	{
278: 		adapter_diag.bad_length++;
279: 		return;
280: 	}
281: 
282: 	address = msg->data[0];
283: 	if (address & 0x3u)
284: 	{
285: 		adapter_diag.bad_alignment++;
286: 		return;
287: 	}
288: 	if (address > UINT32_MAX - sizeof(mailbox_data_t) ||
289: 		address < MBOX0_AP_RAM_START ||
290: 		address + sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > MBOX0_AP_RAM_END)
291: 	{
292: 		adapter_diag.bad_address++;
293: 		return;
294: 	}
295: 	if (rx_count >= MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM)
296: 	{
297: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
298: 		return;
299: 	}
300: 
301: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
302: 	SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((void *)address, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
303: #endif
304: 	__DMB();
305: 	desc = NULL;
306: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
307: 	{
308: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
309: 		{
310: 			desc = &rx_desc[i];
311: 			break;
312: 		}
313: 	}
314: 	if (!desc)
315: 	{
316: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
317: 		return;
318: 	}
319: 	memcpy(&desc->data, (void *)address, sizeof(desc->data));
320: 	adapter_diag.last_rx_header = desc->data.param0;
321: 	ctrl = (desc->data.param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
322: 	if (ctrl == 0)
323: 	{
324: 		/* AP serializes ordinary logical commands.  Receiving the next one
325: 		 * proves that it copied the preceding CP transport ACK, providing an
326: 		 * exact lifetime fence even during a continuous UART/PWC burst. */
327: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
328: 		{
329: 			reaped += mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] != 0;
330: 			mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] = 0;
331: 		}
332: 		adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;
333: 	}
334: 	desc->source = source;
335: 	desc->order = ++rx_order;
336: 	desc->used = 1;
337: 	rx_count++;
338: 	adapter_diag.rx_accepted++;
339: 
340: }

372: bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src,
373: 			 mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
374: {
375: 	mbox0_message_t message;
376: 	mbox0_stable_slot_t *slot;
377: 	uint32_t fifo_status;
378: 	u8 ctrl;
379: 	u8 kind = 0;
380: 	u8 index = 0;
381: 	int ret_code;
382: 
383: 	(void)arg;
384: 	if (src != MAILBOX_CPU0 || dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
385: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
386: 	if (!data)
387: 		return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;

389: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_get_send_stat(dst, &fifo_status);
390: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
391: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
392: 	if (fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_FULL)
393: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;
394: 
395: 	ctrl = (data->param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
396: 	mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
397: 	slot = mbox0_alloc_slot(dst, ctrl, &kind, &index);
398: 	if (!slot)
399: 	{
400: 		adapter_diag.tx_slot_busy++;
401: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
402: 	}
403: 
404: 	memset(slot, 0, sizeof(*slot));
405: 	memcpy(&slot->data, data, sizeof(slot->data));
406: 	mailbox_slots[dst].fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
407: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
408: 	SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((u32 *)slot, sizeof(*slot));
409: #endif

411: 	message.data[0] = (u32)&slot->data;
412: 	message.data[1] = sizeof(slot->data);
413: 	message.dest_cpu = dst;
414: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_send_message(&message);
415: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
416: 	{
417: 		mbox0_release_slot(dst, kind, index);
418: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_NOT_INIT;
419: 	}
420: 	if (ctrl == MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
421: 	{
422: 		adapter_diag.last_ack_header = slot->data.param0;
423: 		adapter_diag.ack_sent++;
424: 	}
425: 	return BK_OK;

428: void bk_mailbox_tx_complete(mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
429: {
430: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
431: 	u32 completed_order;
432: 	u8 i;
433: 
434: 	if (dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
435: 		return;
436: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
437: 	if (!slots->cmd_active)
438: 		return;
439: 	completed_order = slots->cmd_order[slots->cmd_active - 1];
440: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
441: 	{
442: 		if (slots->ack_used[i] && slots->ack_order[i] < completed_order)
443: 			slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
444: 	}
445: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
446: 	{
447: 		if (slots->cmd_used[i] && slots->cmd_order[i] <= completed_order)
448: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
449: 	}
450: 	if (slots->reset_used && slots->reset_order < completed_order)
451: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
452: 	if (slots->sync_used && slots->sync_order < completed_order)
453: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
454: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 MBOX0 v2 physical transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <string.h>
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
13: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
14: 
15: #include "arm_internal.h"
16: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
18: #include "bk7258_boottrace.h"
19: #include "irq.h"
20: 
21: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      (2u * 3u + 1u)
22: #define MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET   8u
23: 
24: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
25: {
26:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
27:   uint32_t order;
28:   bool used;
29: };
30: 
31: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
32: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor g_rx_desc[MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT];
33: static uint32_t g_rx_order;
34: static uint32_t g_processing_order;
35: static bool g_mbox_ready;
36: static bool g_mbox_smp_ready;
37: static struct bk7258_mbox_stats g_stats;
38: 
39: static void mbox_trace_errors(void)
40: {
41:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(4,
42:     (g_stats.bad_source & 0xffu) |
43:     ((g_stats.bad_length & 0xffu) << 8) |
44:     ((g_stats.bad_address & 0xffu) << 16) |
45:     ((g_stats.descriptor_full & 0xffu) << 24));
46: }
47: 
48: _Static_assert(MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT > 2u * 3u,
49:                "RX descriptors must hold a deferred command and two FIFOs");
50: 
51: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
52: {
53:   return getreg32(up_cpu_index() == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
54:                                        BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS);
55: }
56: 
57: static void mbox_clear_errors(int cpu)
58: {
59:   uintptr_t cfg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG;
60:   uint32_t config = getreg32(cfg);
61:   uint32_t errors = config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
62: 
63:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
64:     {
65:       g_stats.write_error++;
66:     }
67: 
68:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
69:     {
70:       g_stats.read_error++;
71:     }
72: 
73:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
74:     {
75:       g_stats.write_full++;
76:     }
77: 
78:   if (errors != 0)
79:     {
80:       putreg32((config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, cfg);
81:     }
82: }
83: 
84: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
85:                                 uint32_t length)
86: {
87:   if (source != 0)
88:     {
89:       g_stats.bad_source++;
90:       mbox_trace_errors();
91:       return false;
92:     }
93: 
94:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
95:     {
96:       g_stats.bad_length++;
97:       mbox_trace_errors();
98:       return false;
99:     }
100: 
101:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
102:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
103:     {
104:       g_stats.bad_address++;
105:       mbox_trace_errors();
106:       return false;
107:     }
108: 
109:   return true;
110: }
111: 
112: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
113: {
114:   uintptr_t status;
115:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
116: 
117:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
118:     {
119:       return -EINVAL;
120:     }
121: 
122: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
123:   if (cpu == 1 && (destination != 1 || data[1] != 0))
124:     {
125:       return -EPERM;
126:     }
127: #endif
128: 
129:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
130:    * receive FIFO status register.
131:    */
132: 
133:   status = destination == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
134:             destination == 1 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
135:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
136:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
137:     {
138:       return -EAGAIN;
139:     }
140: 
141:   putreg32(data[0], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA0 :
142:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA0);
143:   putreg32(data[1], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 :
144:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA1);
145:   putreg32(destination, cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TID :
146:                                   BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TID);
147:   return OK;
148: }
149: 
150: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_alloc_desc(void)
151: {
152:   unsigned int i;
153: 
154:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
155:     {
156:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
157:         {
158:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
159:         }
160:     }
161: 
162:   return NULL;
163: }
164: 
165: static bool mbox_priority_message(
166:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
167: {
168:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
169: 
170:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
171: }
172: 
173: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
174: {
175:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
176:   unsigned int i;
177: 
178:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
179:     {
180:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
181: 
182:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
183:         {
184:           continue;
185:         }
186: 
187:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
188:         {
189:           oldest = desc;
190:         }
191:     }
192: 
193:   return oldest;
194: }
195: 
196: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
197: {
198:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
199:   int ret;
200: 
201:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
202:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
203:    */
204: 
205:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
206:     {
207:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
208:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
209:       g_processing_order = 0;
210:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
211:         {
212:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
213:           break;
214:         }
215: 
216:       desc->used = false;
217:     }
218: 
219:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
220:     {
221:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
222:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
223:       g_processing_order = 0;
224:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
225:         {
226:           break;
227:         }
228: 
229:       desc->used = false;
230:     }
231: }
232: 
233: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
234: {
235:   uintptr_t rdata0;
236:   uintptr_t rdata1;
237:   uintptr_t sidreg;
238:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
239:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
240: 
241:   (void)irq;
242:   (void)context;
243:   (void)arg;
244: 
245:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
246:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() >=
247:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK &&
248:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
249:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER)
250:     {
251:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER);
252:     }
253:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
254:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
255:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
256: 
257:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
258:     {
259:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
260:       uint32_t address;
261:       uint32_t length;
262:       uint8_t source;
263: 
264:       if (cpu == 0)
265:         {
266:           mbox_process_desc();
267:         }
268: 
269:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
270:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
271:         {
272:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
273:           mbox_trace_errors();
274:           break;
275:         }
276: 
277:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
278:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
279:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
280: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
281:       if (length == 0)
282:         {
283:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
284:             {
285:               if (cpu == 1 && address == BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
286:                 {
287:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW);
288:                 }
289: 
290:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
291:             }
292:           else
293:             {
294:               if (cpu == 0)
295:                 {
296:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
297:                   mbox_trace_errors();
298:                 }
299:             }
300: 
301:           continue;
302:         }
303: #endif
304: 
305:       if (cpu != 0)
306:         {
307:           continue;
308:         }
309: 
310:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
311:         {
312:           continue;
313:         }
314: 
315:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
316:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
317:              sizeof(desc->message));
318:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
319:       desc->used = true;

213:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
214:         }
215:       else

217:           g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
218:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
219:           if (g_uart.tx_retry_count == 0)

222:                * once STATE recovery succeeds, but only once.
223:                */

114: static int ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
115: {
116: 	u32   cur_time;
117: 
118: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
119: 
120: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
121: 	{
122: 		return 0;
123: 	}
124: 	if((cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu_x_dump != 0))
125: 	{
126: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
127: 		return 0;
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	if(cur_time >= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)
131: 	{
132: 		cur_time -= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp;
133: 	}
134: 	else
135: 	{
136: 		cur_time += (~(cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around.
137: 	}
138: 
139: 	if(cur_time < HB_TIMEOUT_MS)
140: 	{
141: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
142: 		return 0;
143: 	}
144: 
145: 	if (bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_get(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT))
146: 	{
147: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
148: 		bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_clear(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT);
149: 		return 0;
150: 	}
151: 
152: 	if(s_mb_ipc_work_state == MB_IPC_EXIT_LV)
153: 	{
154: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
155: 		s_mb_ipc_work_state = MB_IPC_WORKING;
156: 		return 0;
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	return 1;
160: }

220: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
221: {
222: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
223: 	u32    events;
224: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
225: 
226: 	mb_ipc_init_lv_callback();
227: 
228: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
229: 
230: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
231: 	{
232: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
233: 		return;
234: 	}
235: 
236: 	while(1)
237: 	{
238: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
239: 
240: 		if(events == 0)
241: 		{
242: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
243: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
244: 		}
245: 
246: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
247: 		{
248: 			if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
249: 			{
250: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
251: 			}
252: 		}
253: 
254: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
255: 		{
256: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
257: 
258: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
259: 			{
260: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
261: 
262: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
263: 				{
264: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
265: 					{
266: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
267: 						break;  // cpu1 power on.
268: 					}
269: 				}
270: 				else
271: 				{
272: 					if( retry_cnt > 3)
273: 					{
274: 						BK_DUMP_OUT("IPC retry to start core%d, retry_cnt:%d\r\n", cpu_x_id, retry_cnt);
275: 						bk_pm_openvela_mailbox_diag_dump();
276: 						// restart_cpu_x();
277: 						break;
278: 					}
279: 					else
280: 					{
281: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);//2s
282: 					}
283: 				}
284: 
285: 				retry_cnt++;
286: 			}
287: 
288: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
289: 		}
290: 
291: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
292: 		{
293: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
294: 			{
295: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC[%d]heartbeat timeout %d,%d\r\n",cpu_x_id,cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp,(u32)rtos_get_time());
296: 				/*when cpu1 heartbeat timeout, then system reboot*/
297: 				cpu_x_heartbeat_timeout = 1;
298: 				ap_console_bridge_link_down();
299: 				BK_ASSERT(false);
300: 			}
301: 		}
302: 
303: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
304: 		{
305: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
306: 		}
307: 		else
308: 		{
309: 			check_time = HB_TIMEOUT_MS;
310: 		}
311: 	}
312: }
